source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Griffith's experiment (PDF 120-121).

blocks.text: 1928 mein British mahir-e-hayatiyat Frederick Griffith ne bimari paida karne wale bacterium Streptococcus pneumoniae par kaam kiya jis ke do strains hain. S-type strain par polysaccharide ka ghilaf hota aur hamwar (smooth) colonies banati hai; R-type strain par ghilaf nahi hota aur khurdari (rough) colonies banati hai.

items: Zinda S-type bacteria chuhon mein inject kiye to mohlik (lethal) saabit hue: chuhon ko pneumonia hua aur woh mar gaye.
Zinda R-type bacteria ka chuhon par koi asar nahi hua.
Garmi se maare S-type bacteria se chuhe tandurust rahe, is liye Griffith ne socha ke mohlik pan polysaccharide ghilaf se ho sakta hai jo S cells ko mezbaan ke mudafiati nizam se bachata hai.
Garmi se maare S-type aur zinda R-type ka mixture, jise bezarar samjha gaya tha, chuhon ko maar gaya, aur un ke khoon mein bohat se zinda S-type bacteria mile.

blocks.alt: Chaar qataarein, har aik mein bacteria ka daira, syringe aur chuha. S-type bacteria (ghilaf wale): chuhe mar gaye. R-type bacteria (bina ghilaf): chuhe sehatmand rahe. Garmi se maare S-type: chuhe sehatmand rahe. Garmi se maare S-type aur zinda R-type ka mixture: chuhe mar gaye aur khoon mein zinda S-type bacteria mile.

blocks.title: Transformation
blocks.text: Griffith ne nateeja nikala ke polysaccharide ghilaf aur mohlik pan banane ki maloomat garmi se maare S-type se zinda R-type bacteria mein gayi, jinhon ne ghilaf banaya aur mohlik S-type ban gaye. Us ne ise transformation kaha: genetic maadde ka aik jandar se doosre mein jana jis se lene wale ki genetic banawat badal jaye. Woh yeh na jaan saka ke muntaqil hone wala maadda DNA tha, protein ya dono.

blocks.title: Maloomat: Avery, MacLeod aur McCarty (1944)
blocks.text: In teen sciencedanon ne transforming principle pehchana. Jab murda S-type bacteria se proteins nikal kar baaqi ko zinda R-type se milaya gaya to inject kiye chuhe phir bhi beemar hue aur zinda S-type bacteria mile, yaani proteins zimmedar nahi the. Jab zinda R-type se milane se pehle murda S-type se saara DNA nikal diya gaya to transformation nahi hui aur chuhe tandurust rahe. Unhon ne nateeja nikala ke DNA hi transforming principle hai.

blocks.prompt: Garmi se maare S aur zinda R cells ke mixture ne chuhe kyun maar diye?
blocks.explanation: Murda S cells ke maadde (baad mein DNA saabit hua) ne zinda R cells ko ghilaf wale mohlik S cells mein badal diya jo barh kar pneumonia ka sabab bane.

items: S strain: ghilaf, hamwar, mohlik; R strain: ghilaf nahi, khurdari, bezarar.
Garmi se maare S + zinda R ne chuhe maare: transformation.
Avery, MacLeod, McCarty (1944): transforming principle DNA hai.
